events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place in Bethel, New York, 57 years ago.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: Imagine being there: 57 years since Woodstock, the festival that defined a generation. What's your ultimate track from that legendary weekend?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley today. His voice, his moves, his legacy – truly one of a kind. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Influential rapper Tupac Shakur passed away after being shot in Las Vegas in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur. His music and words continue to resonate, 30 years on.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Today we remember Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles dropped 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is as iconic as the tracks inside. What's your go-to song?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking it after all these years.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday LG
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that pure rock 'n' roll energy.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' as a single on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: 49 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A powerful message that still resonates today.

events.title: iPod's 25th Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Remember the iPod
angles.copy: 25 years since the original iPod dropped! Remember your first one? The click wheel, the white headphones... pure nostalgia.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, a global celebration of the iconic film franchise, commemorating the release of 'Dr. No' in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite 007 and what's the best Bond theme song? Let us know!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedic genius.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their experimental double album 'The Beatles', commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonders
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped the 'White Album'. A double album packed with diverse sounds and iconic tracks. What's your favourite?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Long Live The Queen
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and legacy are truly immortal.
